intro: Gaea Seeds are hardy plant kernels found along the water's edge of Mirkfallon Lake in the Stonetalon Mountains. Treasured by tauren shamans, they are imbued with elemental blessings to help replenish areas ravaged by war and industry.

p: Gaea Seeds are native to Stonetalon Mountains, naturally washing up or growing around the shores of Mirkfallon Lake. While modest in appearance—resembling small, fibrous coconuts—they carry an inherent resilience. As industrial exploitation and conflict scar Stonetalon, shamanic practitioners view these seeds as vital conduits for healing the wounded earth.
